newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Scholastic Corp rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Scholastic Corp rating cut.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc on Monday said it reduced its rating on Scholastic Corp shares to 3-hold from 2-buy.
-- The downgrade came after a warning last week that the company would report a loss of between $0.70 and $0.80 a share for the third quarter ending February 28 .

-- Barrington said the estimate, which includes a $0.50 charge for expected retail book returns, compared with earnings of $0.55 a share in the same period the previous year and a consensus estimate of a profit of $0.65 a share in the current quarter.

-- The company, which markets children's books and other educational products, is now expecting fiscal 1997 earnings to range between $1.45 and $1.60, down from $2.85, excluding an accounting charge, Barrington Research said.
-- Scholastic said the earnings slide reflected lower-than-expected revenues in its trade distribution and book club businesses.
-- Its shares were down 9/16 at 36-3/16 in late afternoon trading.
